name: pypi-setup-classifiers
note: a plain declarative setup.py with classifiers and python_requires and nothing else. The simplest legitimate sdist. Must stay safe.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup

setup(
    name="datewrangler",
    version="3.1.0",
    packages=["datewrangler"],
    classifiers=[
        "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
        "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    ],
    python_requires=">=3.8",
)
